Container.Name: karting-hub
Container.Overview:
Shareable lap-time dashboard for endurance karting races. Upload Race Monitor lap exports, split each kart into driver stints, give teams and drivers colors and photos, and send friends one link to see their best laps, averages and every lap of the race.
Viewing is open to anyone with the URL. Uploading and editing need the Admin token. Races, the driver and team lists, and photos are stored in the Data folder.
Container.Requires: Supports Unraid's Use Tailscale option (including Funnel): set Tailscale Serve to Funnel and the serve port to 8080. The app runs as PUID:PGID (99:100 by default) and fixes the Data folder's ownership on start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where races, the driver and team lists, and photos are saved. Keep this mapped so they survive restarts and updates.

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Password for uploading and editing races, drivers and teams. Use something long and random. Leave empty for a read-only dashboard.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as and owns the Data folder with.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as and owns the Data folder with.
